text: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京会见来华出席澜湄合作第十一次外长会的柬埔寨副首相兼外交大臣布拉索昆。 王毅说，双方要共同做好下阶段高层交往筹备工作，加强战略沟通，维护共同战略利益。推进“工业发展走廊”和“鱼米走廊”建设，深化基建、农业等领域务实合作。严打电诈不停步，决不让电诈犯罪死灰复燃。推动澜湄合作项目切实落地，不断增进人民福祉。加强在中国-东盟、东亚合作等多边平台协调配合，推动构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系。（外交部网站）
text_en: Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi met in Beijing with Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn, who was in China to attend the 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation (LMC) Foreign Ministers' Meeting. Wang Yi said the two sides should jointly prepare for the next stage of high-level exchanges, strengthen strategic communication and safeguard common strategic interests. They should advance the building of the "Industrial Development Corridor" and the "Fish and Rice Corridor," and deepen practical cooperation in infrastructure, agriculture and other fields. They should crack down on telecom fraud without letup and never allow such crimes to resurge. They should push for the effective implementation of LMC projects to continuously improve people's wellbeing. They should strengthen coordination and cooperation in multilateral platforms such as China-ASEAN and East Asia cooperation, and promote the building of a more just and reasonable global governance system. (Foreign Ministry website)
